text: We're going to the Moon!

The Sun just burst out a huge flash of energy! Invisible fast sun sparks may race to the Moon and could make Raed sick. Get the shelter ready. Its thick walls keep Raed safe! Quick! Prepare the shelter and get inside!
Ouch! Fast sun sparks from the Sun reached the base and the crew was not in the shelter. Thick walls block most radiation, so astronauts hide there during a storm.
Safe! The crew was in the shelter and the radiation was blocked.
The sun sparks did not arrive this time. Preparing cost power, but being ready is what real astronauts do.
The sun sparks did not arrive this time, so Raed was lucky! But nobody can be sure ahead of time, so real astronauts get ready anyway.
Too slow! The shelter was ready, but Raed did not get inside in time, and the radiation hurt.
Raed was too slow to reach the shelter, but luckily no sun sparks came this time. Next time, hurry!
We breathe in oxygen to stay alive. The Moon has no air, so astronauts make and recycle their own. The machines need electricity to run!
Astronauts need clean water to drink and to grow plants. Water is precious in space, so they recycle as much as they can.
Solar panels turn sunlight into electricity. On the Moon, night lasts about two weeks! Power runs the air machines, the plants and the shelter, but there is never enough for everything.
Plants in the greenhouse can make fresh food, but they need water, light and power.

The Sun sometimes bursts out a flash of energy called a solar flare. Fast invisible sun sparks can follow it, and they can make astronauts sick. Thick walls stop most of them, so astronauts hide in a shelter. This game uses real solar flashes recorded by NASA.
A shelter with thick walls blocks most radiation, so astronauts hide there during a storm.
Hearts show how healthy the astronaut is. Keep air, water and food up, and stay safe from radiation.
Moon dust covers the solar panels, so there is a little LESS power today.
The Sun is shining bright, so there is a little MORE power today.
Raed worked hard and drinks a bit more water today.
Almost done! Make this day count.
Raed needs a plan before the day can end. Open the Power Room and choose how much power the air machine and the plant lights get.
Get to the shelter first! Prepare it, then get inside.
Survive 5 days . First, open the Power Room and choose a plan. Then press Next Day . Tip: tap the icons at the top to learn about them!
Hi! I'm Raed! I'm an astronaut living in a base on the Moon. Can you help me survive for 5 days?
